test_strategy: Run actual seeded McAllister to one-shot completion in 250 ms ticks; capture authoritative positions and every outgoing Movement. Assert terminal velocity 0 and stable server position for 60 seconds.
Repeat observer introduction after arrival to distinguish stale advertised velocity from static height.
Compare final server/native client coordinate with exact original collision surface, retaining bridge/deck layer. Do not infer exact final position from endpoint or screenshot.
Existing BootcampOpeningTests advance only 20 ticks after acceptance and verify distance decreased; extend separately to full completion.
A disconnected mesh test for partial paths is separate from this observed complete-route case.
preservation_constraint: Do not replace the estimated destination with an invented placement. Stop signaling and exact grounding should be investigated independently.

original_movement_contract.status: Original Python consumer evidence; native network decoder not fully traced

consumers.behavior: Supplied yaw is applied through body.SetYaw and SyncFacingToYaw; late introduction must therefore receive the current authoritative heading.
Reads body.GetMoveSpeed, initializes stopped gait, and chooses moving gait only above0.01.

original_movement_contract.runtime_packet_contract: ProtocolBufferWriter.WriteMovementData encodes Movement.Velocity at scale1024 and yaw separately; Client.MoveObject uses movement channel1. This is implementation evidence, not an original live packet capture.
original_movement_contract.limitation: This source alone does not prove that the observed suspended officer resulted from stale speed or establish the exact native interpolation/extrapolation algorithm.
